result.rationale: The diff shows next/previous actions set offset then call group.findMembers(), whose .then() setProperties offset/user_count/members from the server response. There is no request serialization, token, or cancellation anywhere in the diff, so two in-flight requests can resolve out of order and the stale response overwrites state. The mechanism is verifiable from the diff (unguarded Discourse.ajax in findMembers, offset mutation before the call in next/previous actions).

judged_text: The next/previous actions fire unguarded async `findMembers()` calls with no request serialization, so rapid next-then-previous clicks can have their responses resolve out of order and the last-resolved stale response overwrites `offset`/`members` via setProperties. An admin clicking quickly through the pager sees the wrong member page displayed (page contents and page counter disagree with the actual requested offset) until they click again.
